t: FireAngel One Smart Smoke Alarm is designed to detect fire using optical sensors. This battery-powered unit is suitable for fitting alarms in hallways, landings, bedrooms and living rooms. The Utra Sense Technology with bug mesh and a maze sensor chamber, protects against false alerts. FireAngel One devices connect via Bluetooth to interlink up to 20 devices wirelessly or via the Angel Connect app and features a 10-year sealed lithium battery to last the lifetime of the alarm.
